spec.assertion: Asserts nero emits NO boss-scoped damageTakenPct (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) and no negative damageTakenPct anywhere. Fails under the nearest-wrong model that encodes an ALLY-side mitigation ▼ using the engine's enemy-debuff stat key — which either cuts team damage (correct sign) or hands the team a phantom +14% amp (flipped sign). Paired with a non-vacuity test proving the mis-encoding genuinely moves the board, so the negative assertion is not testing nothing.

Asserts nero emits no heal of her own, pinning that her `recovery` trigger is ally-fed and therefore never fires in a nero-only reading. The stack pool is the stated gate for burst3's Grumpy Cat, so it is load-bearing but unobservable; an it.skip records why rather than asserting a fictional stack count.

Asserts no buffApply carries a +8.26 damageTakenPct. This IS a genuine team-wide boss amp, but its trigger is "when attacked" and no `attacked` TriggerDef exists; the scope-lock boss deals no damage. Fails under the nearest-wrong model that substitutes passive/interval/shotFired, which would silently amp all five units on an invented cadence.

Asserts no skill-bucket damage instance carries the 158.05% coefficient, plus the stronger claim that nero's total skill-bucket damage is exactly 0. Fails under an ungated shotFired/interval flatDamage encoding, which would give a Defender a phantom damage stream. Doubly gated in the kit: the unavailable "when attacked" trigger AND Grumpy Cat status.

Asserts exactly ONE self-targeted Max HP grant, applied at frame ≤1, with no expiresFrame and no durationShots. Discriminates `passive` from a burstCast/fullBurstEnter re-keying (would emit N grants) and from a timed window (would carry an expiry — the nearest-wrong is borrowing the 5 s or 15 s duration that appears elsewhere in this kit). A leak test pins "Affects self" — no teammate receives it. An inertness test proves removing it changes no unit's damage (nero has no atkOfMaxHpPct scaler), so it is kept for kit completeness per the HP-scaler rule, not for damage.

Asserts one burst-bucket hit per burst cast, carrying the 1104.91% coefficient, with fbMajorApplied falsy and coreRate 0. The FB-exemption is the load-bearing discriminator: burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens, so an FB-boosted encoding over-credits her single largest damage source by ~50%. A halved-coefficient counterfactual proves the assertion is reachable; an inertness test proves her burst moves no teammate's total.
it.skip — no taunt/aggro primitive exists in the schema and the scope-lock boss targets nobody. Damage-neutral under any encoding.

Asserts no buffApply from nero carries the value 60.08, guarding against the amplifier being routed to a damage-side stat. it.skip records the real reason it is unmodelable: the engine models heals as bare recovery events with no HP amount, so a healing-received multiplier has no observable payload, and its only damage-side consumer (skill2b's 158.05% rider) is itself trigger-gapped.

fixtures: controlComp('nero', true) — the standard liter(B1)/crown(B2)/carry(B3)/helm(B3) control with the fixed B3 slot ON. Nero is Burst II, so the fixture must supply a B1 ahead of her and a B3 behind her or the chain never completes and she never casts (a lone/unsupported burst unit makes ZERO Full Bursts, which would make every burst assertion vacuous). The fixed B3 is kept because nothing in this kit reads a teammate's buffs — Nero's only real damage is a flat %-of-own-ATK burst nuke, so helm's buffs cannot confound the coefficient reading, and keeping the slot filled maximises Full Burst count for the fbMajorApplied check. Boss is Fire-neutral per the control; Nero is Fire, so no elemental-advantage term contaminates the burst coefficient assertion. Deterministic — no seed. 6 runComp calls total (1 base + 5 counterfactuals), well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill1b Cat's Repayment stack count — mitigation stats have no damage-side consumer, and her `recovery` trigger is ally-fed with no committed comp pairing nero with a measured-cadence healer.

skill2a 8.26% target Damage Taken ▲ — "30% chance when attacked" has no trigger primitive (no `attacked` TriggerDef) and the scope-lock boss deals no damage; any substituted trigger is an invented cadence that would amp the whole team.
skill2b 158.05% rider — requires BOTH the unavailable `attacked` trigger and a Grumpy Cat status gate fed by ally heals; neither is reachable at scope lock.
burst2 Attract/taunt — no taunt or aggro primitive exists; the boss targets nobody.

burst3 Grumpy Cat incoming healing ▲60.08% — heals carry no HP amount in the engine, so a healing-received multiplier has no observable payload; its only damage-side consumer is itself trigger-gapped.
